name: Mythran
about: Mythran (class 1057), the hermit mage of the Plateau. With Leveling on (game/stat_growth.h) he gives paid lessons that raise INT by one, for the Avatar or a companion walking with him; the lines and prices are in data/stat_growth.json. He has three menus (first meeting, later visits, after the Tongue of Flame); the entry goes on the first menu of each conversation that has a goodbye. INT-gated topic (PLAN-LEVELING.md 5; game/npc_dialog.h 'avatar_int'): shown only when the Avatar's INT is at least the number, behind New Dialogue.

topics.label: If no Titan feeds Thaumaturgy, what does?
say: Ah. A real question. How refreshing. It is always important to ask questions, my friend.
The other schools are pacts: a Titan gives, the caster pays. Thaumaturgy borrows a little from every school and owes allegiance to none.
Where its power truly comes from, I have my suspicions, and they are not the sort one writes down. Suffice it to say it does not ask any Titan's leave.
Which is, I suspect, exactly why the Titans' power can hold you here and yet cannot quite hold my studies. Think on that, and do not repeat it to anyone with a temper.
